entries.prompt: German Air Force Panavia Tornado IDS strike aircraft, exact top-down planform view from directly above, nose pointing right, on plain light grey ground, photographic reference. Swing wings spread at 25 degrees sweep outboard of the fixed triangular wing gloves, long slim fuselage with the pointed black radome, tandem two-seat canopy, the box-shaped intakes either side behind the cockpit, the very tall swept fin seen edge-on along the centreline, all-moving tailerons swept back either side of the twin engine tail, two drop tanks on the swivelling wing pylons, Luftwaffe light grey paint with Iron Cross on each wing. Whole aircraft in frame, symmetrical, no shadows across it, no people, no text.

entries.prompt: German Air Force Panavia Tornado IDS strike aircraft parked on a concrete apron in daylight, three-quarter rear view from the left at eye height, photographic reference. Swing wings spread at 25 degrees sweep with two drop tanks on the swivelling pylons, the very tall swept fin with its root fairing, all-moving tailerons with anhedral either side, two RB199 engine nozzles side by side with the thrust-reverser buckets stowed above them, the long slim fuselage running forward to the tandem two-seat canopy and the black radome, the box intakes behind the cockpit, main gear under the wing gloves, Luftwaffe light grey. Whole aircraft in frame, no people, no text.
